capacity.positive_rate_bulk: every positive-rate bulk therefore has deg H=Theta(M)
capacity.sublinear_Hasse_degree_support: deg H=o(M) iff survivor length ell=o(M), and Item339 proves this support has weighted mass o(M)

first_Hasse_polynomial.left_chart: for r<=n, divide the exact 4F3 prefix by the p-unit C(4r+n-1,n); H_L(z) has degree floor(n/4) and a=prefix*H_L(1) mod p
first_Hasse_polynomial.one_way_gate: ordinary collision => a_(r,n)=0 => H(1)=0; no converse to the original collision is claimed
first_Hasse_polynomial.right_chart: for r>n, reindex the Lucas-surviving tail by j=floor(n/4)-k; H_R(z) has all p-unit coefficients and a=H_R(1) mod p
first_Hasse_polynomial.unified_degree: away from the forced zero ray, deg H=ell(r,n)-1 exactly

formal_Dwork_dash.definition: D_p(x)=(x+l)/p, where 0<=l
formal_Dwork_dash.left_negative_parameter: the 4F3 top tuple always contains -K, K=floor(n/4)<p
formal_Dwork_dash.right_negative_parameter: the forward shifted surviving-tail 5F4 always contains -J, J=deg H<p
formal_Dwork_dash.strict_scope: this is the formal Dwork dash tower of the actual terminating chart; it does not assert the existence of an additional geometric F-crystal
formal_Dwork_dash.tower_consequence: all first-dashed bottom parameters are nonzero; the dashed hypergeometric coefficient sequence has a top parameter 0, so every coefficient of positive index vanishes and every later truncation factor is 1
